webapps.blocked: The app's program files do not arrive. If access goes through Cloudflare Access, the path /webapps/ needs a “Bypass” rule there: the app loads its files without your Cloudflare cookie. The files are public and hold nothing personal.
webapps.center.intro: These programs run right in your browser in a TitanOS window, without Docker and without load on the NAS. TitanOS checks them and brings new versions with its updates.
webapps.center.noVolume: Installing needs a volume: the programs are kept on the volume, not on the stick.
webapps.center.photocraftWhy: The web version from storytold lacks a file the app loads at start. Once a version starts, it can be installed here.
webapps.center.removeText: {app} disappears from the desktop of every account. Your files stay where they are. You can install the program again at any time.
webapps.center.title: Programs for the browser
webapps.conflictText: “{name}” changed since you opened it (by someone else or in another window). Overwriting replaces that version with yours.
webapps.dialog.name: File name
webapps.dialog.replaceHint: “{name}” already exists here. You will be asked whether to replace it.
webapps.migrate.item.kept: Kept (the browser program was not installed)
webapps.migrate.moreText: The programs are kept on your data volume (not on the stick) and run sealed off: they see neither your login nor any files other than the ones you open. Settings of the programs themselves (such as recently used fonts) are not remembered in that sealed-off window. Install or remove them at any time under App Center › Programs for the browser; Files › Settings › Default apps sets what a double click opens.
webapps.migrate.onNode: For the node “{name}” of the cluster.
webapps.migrate.title: Office programs right in the browser
webapps.migrate.whyText: From TitanOS 0.63 these programs run right in your browser, in a TitanOS window. That is faster than before, needs no container and no memory on the NAS, and works wherever you reach TitanOS – on the go and on your phone, too. You open documents with a double click in the file manager, and saving writes straight into the original file. The programs are checked by TitanOS and come with TitanOS updates.
webapps.migrate.whyTitle: Why T-Word, T-Exel and T-PDF are now installed this way
webapps.openFailed: The file could not be opened: {error}
webapps.replaceText: “{name}” already exists in this folder. Replacing overwrites it.
webapps.saveAsHint: {app} did not open Save As. Choose it in the app itself (File › Save As). TitanOS then asks for the folder and the name.
webapps.saveFailed: Not saved: {error}. Your changes are still in the app.
webapps.slow: The app does not answer. You can restart it or open it in a tab of its own.
webapps.standard.intro: Which program a double click in the file manager opens. Applies to your account only.
webapps.standard.none: No programs for the browser are installed. You can install them in the App Center.
webapps.standard.title: Default apps
webapps.unknownApp: This app is not installed on the NAS (any more).
webapps.unsavedRestart: {app} has changes that are not saved. Restarting loses them.
webapps.unsavedText: {app} has changes that are not saved. Closing loses them.
webapps.volume.hint: Your documents stay where they are. You can change the location later in the App Center.
webapps.volume.moveText: All installed programs move to the chosen volume. Your documents stay where they are. Until a program is ready in its new place, it keeps running from the old one.
welcome.officeLater: More programs, and removing them, are in the App Center under “Programs for the browser”.
welcome.officeNoVolume: They are installed as soon as the first volume exists (they are kept on the volume, not on the stick).
welcome.officeText: T-Word, T-Exel and T-PDF open Word, Excel and PDF files right in the browser, in a TitanOS window: double-click in the file manager, saving writes the original file. They run on your device, not on the NAS, and come checked with TitanOS updates.
welcome.officeUnavailable: This NAS does not offer programs for the browser yet.
